description: This file defines the DeviceStatusService class, which implements device status reporting functions including battery, thermal, storage, network, and device info for an iOS application.

classes.name: DeviceStatusService
classes.description: A final class providing device status information such as battery, thermal, storage, network, and device info for an iOS device.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Asynchronously collects various device status metrics and returns an OpenClawDeviceStatusPayload.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns device information payload, including device name, model, system version, app version, build, and locale.

methods.name: batteryStatus
methods.description: Provides the current battery level and state, with capacity for low power mode status.

methods.name: thermalStatus
methods.description: Returns the current thermal state of the device.

methods.name: storageStatus
methods.description: Retrieves storage attributes such as total, free, and used space.

methods.name: fallbackAppBuild
methods.description: Provides a fallback value for app build if the actual build string is empty.
